## Description {#details}

<p>This class can be used for tracking most instruction setters.</p>


<p>The two template arguments are:</p>


<ul class="doxyList ">
<li>GetterFn: The getter member function pointer (e.g., <span class="doxyComputerOutput">&amp;Foo::get</span>)</li>
<li>SetterFn: The setter member function pointer (e.g., <span class="doxyComputerOutput">&amp;Foo::set</span>) Upon construction, it saves a copy of the original value by calling the getter function. Revert sets the value back to the one saved, using the setter function provided.</li>
</ul>

<p>Example: Tracker.track(std::make_unique&lt;
               GenericSetter&lt;&amp;FooInst::get, &amp;FooInst::set&gt;&gt;(I, Tracker));</p>


<p>Definition at line 275 of file <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/files/include/include/llvm/include/llvm/sandboxir/tracker-h">Tracker.h</a>.</p>
